title: For administratively up ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'po
question: For administratively up ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports', list each port’s name, MAC address, port security enabled flag, and its row number ordered by MAC address (using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row). Also include, for that port’s status and device owner, the total number of such ports and the earliest standard-attribute updated timestamp. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base_ports AS (
  SELECT 
    p.id AS port_id,
    p.name AS port_name,
    p.mac_address AS mac_address,
    p.status AS port_status,
    p.device_owner AS device_owner,
    psb.port_security_enabled AS port_security_enabled,
    sa.updated_at AS standard_attr_updated_at
  FROM `ports` AS p
  JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON p.standard_attr_id = sa.id
  LEFT JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id
  WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1
    AND sa.resource_type = 'ports'
),
windowed_ports AS (
  SELECT 
    bp.port_id,
    bp.port_name,
    bp.mac_address,
    bp.port_status,
    bp.device_owner,
    bp.port_security_enabled,
    bp.standard_attr_updated_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY bp.mac_address) AS row_number
  FROM base_ports AS bp
),
status_owner_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    port_status,
    device_owner,
    COUNT(port_id) AS total_ports,
    MIN(standard_attr_updated_at) AS earliest_standard_attr_updated
  FROM base_ports
  GROUP BY port_status, device_owner
)
SELECT 
  wp.port_name,
  wp.mac_address,
  wp.port_security_enabled,
  wp.row_number,
  sos.total_ports,
  sos.earliest_standard_attr_updated
FROM windowed_ports AS wp
JOIN status_owner_stats AS sos ON wp.port_status = sos.port_status AND wp.device_owner = sos.device_owner
ORDER BY wp.mac_address
